picks.title: This tiny AI box could save me from upgrading my perfectly good laptop
picks.excerpt: Violoop showed a small hardware AI assistant at IFA 2026 that plugs into an existing Windows PC or Mac, reads on-screen workflows, performs multi-step actions and keeps its memory graph on-device.
picks.rationale: An external agent box that upgrades an old machine instead of replacing it — the most practical AI-hardware idea from IFA.

picks.title: These earbuds may be the only translation tool you need overseas
picks.excerpt: Timekettle's W4 Plus interpreter earbuds run Babel OS 3.0, cover 52 languages with 13 offline pairs, translate calls inside Zoom and WhatsApp, and add conversation memory plus live summaries.
picks.rationale: A shipping product, not a concept: real-time interpretation that changes how cross-language work meetings run.

picks.title: This New iRobot Concept Is the Matryoshka of Robot Vacuums
picks.excerpt: iRobot's Roomba Duo concept at IFA 2026 carries a smaller companion robot in a cavity and lowers it with a mechanical arm to reach spaces the main bot cannot.
picks.rationale: A robot that deploys another robot — a concrete answer to the reach limits that have capped home robotics.

picks.title: I just went hands-on with the Odyss N1 — a sleek AI necklace that automatically logs everything you eat
picks.excerpt: A triangular metal pendant with a camera and accelerometer, shown as a concept at IFA 2026, detects what and when the wearer eats without any manual photographing or logging.
picks.rationale: Passive sensing instead of user input — the clearest example this week of AI removing a logging chore entirely.

picks.title: Apple Watch Series 12: Three new features coming next week
picks.excerpt: Apple Watch Series 12, expected at the September 9 event, is reported to bring a faster S-series chip built for the Siri AI era, plus sensing upgrades.
picks.rationale: The first Apple Watch silicon designed around on-device Siri AI — sets the baseline for wrist-level assistants.
